display_long_description:
The farm is booming and every order is urgent. Put on your headset, roll up your sleeves and become the fastest farmhand in the valley!

MILK LIKE YOU MEAN IT
Grab a teat and pull down with real hand motions — smooth, steady strokes fill your bucket, frantic yanking gets you nowhere. Keep the bucket level or precious milk spills everywhere. Unlock two-handed milking to hit top speed.

FROM MILK TO CHEESE
Carry the bucket to the work table, churn with the paddle in real circles, portion the fresh cheese wheel, box it up and rush it to the delivery zone before time runs out.

EGG DUTY
The hens are waiting! Keep their feed and water topped up, collect the eggs and pack them six to a carton. Careful — eggs break, and broken eggs cost points.

RACE FOR THE STARS
20 timed missions with rising difficulty, combo-driven scoring, accuracy bonuses and a star rating on every run. Chase perfect deliveries and beat your best scores.

FEATURES
• Physical, gesture-based milking, churning and egg handling
• Two farm jobs: the dairy barn and the hen house
• Combo scoring, accuracy bonuses and 3-star mission ratings
• Haptic feedback for every grab, stroke and pour
• From your first wheel of cheese to the ultimate Milking Rush
